scenes.narration: Jupiter is your bodyguard and your biggest threat.
The answer: both. It throws some comets away, and flings others toward us.
At its closest, light from Earth takes about thirty-five minutes to arrive.
Jupiter is so big that about thirteen hundred Earths could fit inside.
It outweighs all the other planets combined, more than twice over.
In nineteen ninety-four, the whole world watched it take a hit for real.
Comet Shoemaker-Levy nine broke into pieces and slammed into Jupiter's clouds for days.
Some of the impact scars were bigger than our entire planet.
Its Great Red Spot is a single storm wider than the whole Earth.
And despite that size, one full day here lasts under ten hours.
But the next planet hides something stranger, and it's slowly disappearing.
Next stop, Saturn. Will its rings vanish one day? Yes or no?
